variant.description: Footer layout variant. 'big' includes collapsible nav columns and an optional sign-up form. 'medium' shows flat primary links. 'slim' puts contact info in the primary bar.

returnToTop.description: Show the 'Return to top' link. Set false to hide.

returnToTopHref.description: Anchor href for the return-to-top link.

navColumns.description: (big variant) Array of nav column objects: [{ heading, links: [{ text, href, ariaLabel? }] }]

navLinks.description: (medium/slim variants) Array of primary nav links: [{ text, href, ariaLabel? }]

navAriaLabel.description: Accessible aria-label for the footer nav element.

signUp.description: (big variant, optional) Email sign-up config: { heading?, emailLabel?, emailId?, buttonText?, action? }

branding.description: Branding config (same shape as Header branding): { title?, symbol?, logo?, alt? }. Use 'symbol' + 'title' to show a decorative image beside agency name text. Use 'logo' for a full standalone logo image (title used as alt text).

brandingUrl.description: URL for the branding link (wraps the logo/symbol image and title).

socialLinks.description: Array of social icon links: [{ icon (img src), href, alt }]

contactHeading.description: Heading label above the contact info block.

contactPhone.description: Phone contact. Object: { href, text } — or a plain string (auto-prefixed with tel:).

contactEmail.description: Email contact. Object: { href, text } — or a plain string (auto-prefixed with mailto:).

className.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the root footer element.
